Owner-operated

Meet Omar — the person who answers, and the person who shows up

TaskCraft isn’t a call centre or a franchise. It’s run by Omar, a Mississauga-based installer who personally does the work — from TV mounting and IKEA builds to bidets, cameras and Wi-Fi. When you message TaskCraft, you’re messaging Omar directly, and he’s the one who comes to your door.

Omar works across Mississauga, Toronto, Brampton and the GTA, speaks English and Arabic (نتكلم عربي), and takes every booking by WhatsApp message — so your quote, your time and your job details are all in writing, in one thread.

  • ✓ Owner-operated — Omar does the work himself

  • ✓ Tidy finish — packaging and mess cleaned up
  • ✓ Honest scope — if a job needs a licensed electrician or plumber, we say so
  • ✓ Open 7 days, 8 AM – 9 PM, booked by message

Questions

Before you book

How do I book?

By WhatsApp message to 647-621-3211. Send the service you need, your city, and a photo of the job if you can. You’ll get a reply with a quote and an available time. Booking by message means you can send it anytime — replies come during service hours, 8 AM to 9 PM daily.

Which areas do you cover?

Mississauga (our home base), Toronto, Brampton and the wider GTA. If you’re just outside those areas, message anyway and ask — it depends on the job.

Do I need to buy the parts and materials myself?

Usually yes for the main item — the TV mount, bidet kit, camera, lock, faucet or IKEA furniture — and we fit it. If you’re not sure what to buy, message a photo or a link first and we’ll tell you if it’s the right one before you spend money.

Can you assemble IKEA kitchen cabinets and wardrobes?

Yes — IKEA kitchen cabinet installation and wardrobe / closet systems are core services, along with general flat-pack furniture assembly.

What don’t you do?

We don’t do lawn cutting, drywall and plaster repair, ceiling fan or light-fixture electrical work, gazebo assembly, moving-house furniture disassembly, or smoke / CO detector installation. If a job needs a licensed electrician or plumber, we’ll say so honestly in our reply.

How is the price set?

By the job, quoted in the WhatsApp reply before any work starts — based on the service, the size of the job and what’s involved. Send photos for the most accurate quote.

Got a job sitting on your list?

Send one WhatsApp message with a photo of it. That’s the whole booking process.
